pv.name: huawei_pv_generation_watts
pv.help: Current PV (inverter input) power in watts.

export.name: huawei_grid_export_watts
export.help: Current power exported to the grid in watts (>= 0).

import.name: huawei_grid_import_watts
import.help: Current power imported from the grid in watts (>= 0).

home.name: huawei_home_consumption_watts
home.help: Home consumption in watts (PV input minus battery power minus net grid power).

grid.name: huawei_grid_net_watts
grid.help: Net grid power in watts (positive = export by default).

batt_net.name: huawei_battery_net_watts
batt_net.help: Battery net power in watts (positive = charging, negative = discharging).

batt_charge.name: huawei_battery_charge_watts
batt_charge.help: Battery charging power in watts (0 when not charging).

batt_discharge.name: huawei_battery_discharge_watts
batt_discharge.help: Battery discharging power in watts (0 when not discharging).

batt_soc.name: huawei_battery_soc_percent
batt_soc.help: Battery state of charge in percent.

cache_device_up.name: huawei_cache_device_up
cache_device_up.help: 1 when the modbus-cache in front of the device finished its last poll cycle with at least one successful read, 0 when the device is unreachable behind the cache.

cache_age.name: huawei_cache_age_seconds
cache_age.help: Seconds since the modbus-cache's last successful device read (65535 = none yet). Grows while the device is down behind the cache.

cache_uptime.name: huawei_cache_uptime_seconds
cache_uptime.help: Uptime of the modbus-cache process in seconds.

battery.name: huawei_battery
battery.help: 1 if battery support is enabled (always exported).

up.name: huawei_up
up.help: 1 if the last Modbus poll of the inverter succeeded.

modbus_errors.name: huawei_modbus_errors_total
modbus_errors.help: Total failed or rejected polls since start.

last_poll.name: huawei_last_poll_timestamp_seconds
last_poll.help: Unix time of the last successful poll.
